instruction: Disable the navigation pane in LibreOffice Impress so only the slide editing area is visible.

metadata.explanation: Task requires hiding the left navigation pane (View > Slide Pane to uncheck). Evaluator checks the LeftPaneVisible setting is set to false in registrymodifications.xcu.
metadata.verification_method: Configuration file structure verified by reading existing check_presenter_console_disable function and LibreOffice registry XML schema
